summary: A Depth subscription to an index: the index feed's tick comes out as a full frame with the price and the day's range, and no book.

deviations.reason: The web's Kotak adapter puts no mode in data; the desktop sends the label (ltp, quote, full). The key follows the broker's web adapter; set in the per-broker dialect entry (lane wire) in Phase B.

An SFeed index packet carries no volume; the web's index normaliser writes volume 0 (sfeed_websocket.py::_to_index) and publishes it, a zero the exchange never sent. The desktop leaves it out (web openalgo#2376).
The desktop's index frame carries the change since the previous close under the canonical names as well as percent_change; the web's Kotak index frame has percent_change only.
deviations.ref: feed::bridge::quote_fields (index change fields, lane wire C04)

deviations.reason: The web's Kotak adapter answers a Depth subscription to an index with its price over an empty book (depth: {buy: [], sell: []}); the desktop's frame for an index has no depth key.
deviations.ref: kotak_adapter.py:617-640; feed::protocol::market_data (no book for an index)

deviations.reason: An index has no book; the web sends its book totals as 0 under the Kotak name (extras.get(..., 0)), numbers the exchange never sent. The desktop leaves them out.
